title: Recording a Recipient-Name Correction on a Cash Pickup Transfer
content:
## The correction

The agent records a correction of the recipient name on a Cash Pickup transfer exactly as the customer gives it, so that it matches the recipient's government ID. The corrected name replaces the name on the transfer at once, and the Pickup Number does not change.

## Spelling only

The corrected name may differ from the recipient name currently on the transfer by at most the tier's limit of correctable characters. Each single-character insertion, deletion or substitution counts as one, and letter case and accent marks are both ignored, so a letter differing only by its accent is not counted. A correction of more characters is a different person.

Hypothetical names, with a limit of 2 characters:

| Name on the transfer | Corrected name | Characters counted | Within a limit of 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jose Perez | José Pérez | 0, accents only | yes |
| ROSA MARTINEZ | Rosa Martínez | 0, case and accent only | yes |
| Maria Lopes | María López | 1 | yes |
| Lucia Fernandes | Lucía Hernández | 2 | yes |
| Carlos Mendes | Karla Mendes | 3 | no, a different person |

## Corrections beyond the free ones

A name correction beyond the free corrections is not recorded until the transfer's ledger carries the name-correction fee charge numbered with that correction's number.

That number is the corrections already recorded on the transfer plus one. While the ledger carries no name-correction fee charge with that number, a correction beyond the free ones is not recorded.

## Expired pickups

On a pickup that has expired, the days a name correction adds to the pickup window are fixed only after the pickup stands reactivated, with its reactivation count raised and its last day of collection no earlier than the day of the correction.

## The tool

The tool is `record_name_correction_726c5192`, an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it.

One call does all of the following:
- adds one name-correction case dated today, keeping the name it replaces and numbered as the next correction on the transfer;
- replaces the name the cash is released to with the corrected name at once;
- moves the last day of collection later by the extension days given.

The Pickup Number does not change. The recipient can then collect with an ID showing the corrected name.

## Parameters

- `cash_transfer_id`: the reference number of the Cash Pickup transfer whose recipient name is corrected, as returned by the Cash Pickup transfer lookup. Identifier.
- `corrected_name`: the recipient's full name exactly as the customer spells it from the recipient's government ID. It is copied character for character with its accents, spacing and capitals, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion. Verbatim text.
- `extension_days`: the number of calendar days by which the last day of collection moves later, as a whole non-negative integer. A value of 0 keeps it unchanged.

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with these fields:
- `status`: "corrected" when the correction was recorded;
- `case_id`: the reference of the correction case;
- `correction_seq`: the number of this correction on the transfer;
- `previous_name`: the name replaced;
- `corrected_name`: the name the cash is now released to;
- `pickup_expiry_date`: the last day of collection, including the extension.
